In the Bunka-era spring of 1809, in a riverside merchant townhouse in Kyōbashi, Edo, these three Japanese women—twenty-six-year-old Hana with her round face and short-statured build, hair in Shimada-style with one polished lacquer pin slipping; thirty-year-old Sachi with her longer oval face and broader shoulders, hair in Katsuyama-style with malachite-threaded ornaments; thirty-four-year-old Toshi with her narrow mature jaw and tall frame, hair in Maru-mage with faded vermilion ribbons—wear layered kosode in varying states of looseness: Hana's beni-red blossom-patterned robes gapping at the chest, Sachi's ai-indigo water-motif sleeves tangled with Hana's sash, Toshi's cream-ground crane-patterned outer robe sliding from one shoulder as she leans in; all three faces show open-mouthed laughter with crinkled eyes, Hana's gaze flying toward her stolen obi, Sachi's meeting Toshi's in shared mischief, Toshi's directed downward at the lower strip. The lower prop strip crops a woven bamboo basket overturned on its side, the pet tanuki's striped back and fluffy tail visible as it drags the crimson obi toward image-left; the central tableau compresses the three women's tangled embrace into one interlocked silhouette of reaching arms, pressing hands, and sliding silk; the upper strip shows a smoke-darkened shoji lattice with faint bokashi from ai indigo to warm cream suggesting evening spring light, one rectangular paper panel bulging as if the tanuki has bumped it from behind. Dominant flat silhouettes emerge from Toshi's tall crane-patterned back and angled fan, Sachi's crouching indigo mass with one red sleeve streaming outward, Hana's kneeling red form with hair mass and exposed shoulder; crisp overlap where Sachi's hand enters Hana's robe, where Toshi's fan crosses Sachi's hair ornament, where Hana's loosened obi threads between all three waists; a diagonal thrust from the lower-left basket through the central body cluster to upper-right shoji corner; negative space as a pale wedge between Toshi's raised knee and the wall. The four-to-six-color Edo pigment hierarchy anchors on ai-indigo dark edges and Sachi's robe mass, warms through beni-red on Hana's kimono and obi plus vermilion accent in Toshi's ribbons and lip detail, grounds on warm cream washi in upper strips and Toshi's base robe, with malachite thread as small bounded spark in Sachi's hair ornaments; contour-enclosed matte fields separate each pigment zone with dark piping at every garment edge and hair boundary; one warm skin base carries across all three faces with one bounded beni blush at Hana's exposed chest and Sachi's laughing cheeks; one bokashi-style gradient drifts ai indigo to cream across the upper shoji lattice only, never touching bodies or lower strip.
